description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages for four different methods—CoD, CCoT, CoUT, and an unlabeled red bar—each represented by a distinct colored bar. The horizontal axis lists the method names, with CoD (orange), CCoT (light blue), CoUT (green), and an unlabeled red bar positioned from left to right. The vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and ranges from 75 to 95 in increments of 5, indicating the percentage of correct predictions. Each bar is annotated with its exact value: the red bar is 91.19%, the orange CoD bar is 80.89%, the light blue CCoT bar is 88.50%, the green CoUT bar is 88.40%, and the second red bar (which appears to be the same method as the first) is 676.85%. The second red bar is significantly taller than all others, extending beyond the 95% mark on the vertical axis, suggesting it represents a different metric or scale, while the other three bars are clustered between 80% and 91%. The bars are not sorted by value; they are presented in the order CoD, CCoT, CoUT, followed by the second red bar. The chart includes a legend indicating that the green bar corresponds to CoUT, while the other colors are implicitly associated with their respective method labels. The bars are presented without any visual emphasis such as shading or bolding.
